projects.name: Leo's Toy Rotation
projects.description: Picks one toy per category for Leo every other Friday at 5pm. Rate the last set, swap or hand-pick toys, then confirm to update the toy sheet and email the list.
projects.notes:
Toy sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1FOxLlQe8fKy9fXsXsq5efUUEieQTIvtWTMWyUG-i__I/edit
Snapshots (Toy History folder): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1iZ_whg7oDBPRvPVYj7Y7PCN_qu20Gixk

The Code link opens the Google Apps Script project. After changing the code, publish with Deploy > Manage deployments > Edit > New version so the page link stays the same.
Sheet menu (Toy Rotation): open page, send reminder now, refresh pictures, sort toys, save or restore a snapshot.
